subject: Cobalt Freight joins the Meridian Logistics family
text:
Dear Valued Customer,

We are delighted to share that Cobalt Freight LLC has become part of Meridian Logistics Holdings. You will continue to work with the same drivers, dispatchers and account managers you know.

As we bring our organizations together, invoices issued on or after January 4 will carry the Meridian name. Those invoices should be paid to Meridian Logistics Holdings Inc. at the remit-to information printed on them, and not to Cobalt Freight's existing account. An updated W-9 is attached.

We look forward to serving you as one company.

Warm regards,
The Integration Office
label: change_request
note: Payee moves to acquirer, wrapped in marketing tone.
